mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right size for my tiny-home shell?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right size depends on your lifestyle, intended use, and the number of occupants. Consider what furniture, appliances, and personal belongings you need to accommodate. Also, think about any local regulations regarding tiny home dimensions, especially for tiny houses on wheels where width and length are often restricted for road legality. We can guide you through common dimensions and help assess how much space you genuinely require.
